neighbours.label: web-service architecture context: 'Web' in Web services, SOAP calls, microservices, REST APIs
fire: The toolkit offers data access builders such as the SQL builders or the REST or Web service builders.
This class manages Web Services Definition Language files for the client.
Set the default timeout to use with all SOAP calls made by the client library.
Containers cut the time needed to deploy new features or new microservices.
The orchestration layer routes each request to one of several backend micro services.
Our legacy system exposes its billing functions as SOAP Web services.
Each team owns a small microservice that talks to the others over REST.
The gateway translates between the old Web service interface and the new APIs.
quiet: The toolkit offers data access builders such as the SQL builders or the file import builders.
This class manages configuration files written in plain text for the client.
Set the default font size to use with all printed reports made by the library.
Containers cut the time needed to install new features on old laptops.
The scheduling layer assigns each job to one of several local worker threads.
Our legacy system stores its billing records in a single large spreadsheet.
Each team owns a small module that is compiled into one desktop program.
The converter translates between the old file format and the new spreadsheets.
